clauses.why: The name Zachariah is right, but "killed him before the people" blurs the order: he struck him before the people, then slew him; the line also leaves out that he became king.
clauses.english: conspired against Zachariah, struck him before the people and killed him
clauses.ukr: вчинив змову на Захарія, бив його перед народом і вбив його
clauses.deu: machte einen Bund wider Sacharja, schlug ihn vor dem Volk und tötete ihn
clauses.spa: se conjuró contra Zachârías, lo hirió en presencia de su pueblo y lo mató

answer.note: The line leaves out that he became king in Zachariah's place and reigned one month in Samaria (2KI 15:10, 13).
